verdict.rationale: Bitbucket's own docs describe pull request code review with a PR screen and the ability to 'review large diffs with ease'. A community post confirms that PRs carry comment threads. Inline, line-anchored review comments placed alongside the code are not explicitly documented. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of inline line-level comments, documented PR creation flow and diff comparison modes, independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can open a pull request, compare diffs, and leave inline review comments alongside the code

citations.quote: Comprehensive code review features to help you find and fix bugs before you deploy. Review large diffs with ease
open Jira tickets right from the PR screen
wants to preserve pull requests and comment threads
